Kalyan Jewellers Reports 26% Revenue Growth in Q2

Kalyan Jewellers India reported a consolidated revenue growth of over 26% for the July-September quarter of FY27 compared to the same period last year. The company also recorded 20% same-store-sales growth and plans to launch four additional showrooms under the franchised model within the current financial year. Following the business update, shares of the company rose 2% on the BSE.
